text:
Iris: Heads-up: FluxGrid marketplace listing + joint integration launch targeted for 6/24. Need landing copy, webinar plan, benchmark blurb, and inbound lead routing. Who can own each piece?
Ben: I'll take lead routing. Proposal: utm_source=fluxgrid, utm_medium=marketplace, campaign=FLX-MKT-0624. Add hidden field partner=fluxgrid and campaign_code=FLX-0624 on all forms. Dedupe by email+company+campaign.
Sofia: Webinar run-of-show idea: 5m intros, 15m problem framing, 25m live end-to-end integration demo, 10m customer case + 10m Q&A. Need demo scripts + 3 succinct CTAs on page.
Marco: Partner prefers webhook delivery if DPA signed; fallback nightly SFTP with PGP. They want lead CSV + raw event log for webinar interactions.
Ben: Routing rules (draft):
- partner_opt_in=true & role in (Engineer, PM, Integrations) -> partner SDR queue (real-time if webhook, else nightly)
- lead_score >= 80 or enterprise=true -> Redwood AE handoff, notify partner
- webinar_attended=true and watch_pct>=50 -> bump lead_score + route to AE if score crosses threshold
Sofia: Landing fields: email, first_name, last_name, company, role, region, primary_use_case (dropdown), partner_share (checkbox). default unchecked.
Iris: Benchmark narrative: show two micro-benchmarks: baseline single-node inference vs Redwood+FluxGrid routing with batching + KV-cache. Method: 10 warmup requests, sample 200 prompt runs, report median p50/p95 latencies and $/1k tokens. Include hardware note and reproducible script link. Keep paragraph <150 words.
Marco: CSV header for nightly drop (sample):
```
email,first_name,last_name,company,region,role,partner_opt_in,utm_source,campaign_code,marketo_id,lead_score,webinar_registered,webinar_attended,watch_pct,notes
```
Ben: Also add a field "first_touch_channel" so we can credit marketplace vs ads. Credit rules: first_touch=marketplace grants partner primary attribution unless lead explicitly requests partner not be shared.
Sofia: CTAs for page: 1) Register for webinar (primary), 2) Try integration sandbox (dev button), 3) Request enterprise demo (enterprise form).
Iris: Assignments: Ben = HubSpot/Marketo flows + dedupe rules (due 6/5), Marco = partner delivery + keys + sample CSV (due 6/3), Sofia = landing + run-of-show + CTAs (due 6/7), Iris = benchmark blurb + blog outline (due 6/10). ops-bot: Created event "FluxGrid launch ops sync" 6/6 9:30am PT - https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/fluxgrid-launch
Marco: PGP public key uploaded to partner bucket. I also uploaded a `fluxgrid-sample-nightly.csv` to shared folder.
Ben: I'll add Marketo smart lists and the webhook endpoint (if DPA in place). Will drop screenshots and mapping doc in the tracking doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/fluxgrid-launch
Iris: Solid. Keep benchmark language focused on reproducibility and include a clear call to reproduce. Final sync 6/6. :rocket:
